# Configuration reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-config-docs.py — edit chart/values.yaml instead -->

Every key below is a field of `config:` in the chart values. It is rendered into one
ConfigMap and read as environment variables by the balancer.

Defaults are the chart defaults, which are intentionally conservative:
`MODE=dry-run` and `suspend: true`. Start there, watch the plan for a few days,
then flip `MODE` to `live`.

The effective values of a running round are dumped in its first log line
(`{"kind":"config"}`) — use that when a key seems to have no effect. A misspelled
key silently falls back to its built-in default.

_43 keys._

## master switch

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `MODE` | `"dry-run"` | dry-run = log the plan only \| live = evict \| off = exit immediately |
| `STATE_CM` | `""` | "<ns>/<name>"; empty = the namespace the balancer runs in |
| `CFG_CM` | `""` | where this ConfigMap lives; empty = own namespace |
| `CLUSTER_NAME` | `"cluster"` | shown in notification text only |

## cordon labels

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CORDON_LABEL` | `"node-leveler/cordoned"` | label on nodes during a guided move (value = epoch seconds) |
| `CORDON_LABEL_LEGACY` | `""` | also heal this older label; leave empty on a fresh deploy |

## scope: which nodes and workloads

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `POOL_LABEL` | `"node-pool"` | node label that defines a pool (set to your own key) |
| `POOLS` | `""` | pools to scan, as <label value>/<CPU count>; empty = nothing is scanned |
| `NS_INCLUDE` | `"^$"` | regex: namespaces that may be touched; "^$" matches nothing |
| `ALLOW_STS_NS` | `""` | regex: namespaces whose StatefulSets may move (empty = none) |
| `DENY_WORKLOADS` | `""` | <ns>/<workload> globs that are never touched |

## quotas and cooldowns

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `MAX_PER_CYCLE` | `"4"` | moves per round |
| `MAX_PER_NODE` | `"4"` | moves out of one source node per round |
| `MAX_PER_NS` | `"2"` | moves per namespace per round |
| `MAX_SINGLE_REPLICA` | `"0"` | single-replica workloads per round (0 = never: each move is a real restart) |
| `MAX_STS_PER_CYCLE` | `"0"` | StatefulSets per round (same-zone moves only) |
| `DAILY_BUDGET` | `"100"` | moves per rolling 24h; the one gate that fails silently |
| `COOLDOWN_HOURS` | `"6"` | per-workload cooldown after a move |

## source waterlines (when a node counts as "too full")

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `POD_HIGH` | `"95"` | pod-slot % at which a node becomes a source |
| `MEM_BASIS` | `"physical"` | judge hot nodes by physical memory (recommended) or allocatable |
| `MEM_ACT_HIGH` | `"85"` | real memory % at which a node becomes a source |
| `CPU_ACT_HIGH` | `"60"` | real CPU % at which a node becomes a source |

## target ceilings (what a node may receive)

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `RELIEF_CORES` | `"0.5"` | minimum relief in cores (CPU dimensions only) |
| `RELIEF_GI` | `"0.5"` | minimum relief in GiB (memory dimensions only) |
| `TARGET_POD_MAX` | `"90"` | post-move pod-slot % ceiling |
| `TARGET_MEMUSE_MAX` | `"90"` | current real memory % ceiling; denominator set by TARGET_MEMUSE_BASIS |
| `TARGET_MEMUSE_BASIS` | `"physical"` | physical = real/physical (recommended) \| alloc = real/allocatable |
| `PHYS_AFTER_MEM_MAX` | `"85"` | post-move physical memory % hard cap (the OOM guard) |

## pool-level behaviour

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `POOL_SLOT_NOTIFY` | `"85"` | alert when a whole pool exceeds this slot % |
| `POOL_SLOT_PRESSURE` | `"85"` | start draining the fullest pool at this slot %; 0 disables the driver |
| `POOL_PRESSURE_SRC_MIN` | `"85"` | inside that pool, nodes above this slot % become sources |

## placement guidance and guards

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SETTLE_TIMEOUT` | `"300"` | seconds to wait for a replacement Deployment pod |
| `STS_SETTLE_TIMEOUT` | `"300"` | seconds to wait for a StatefulSet pod (slower: volumes + cluster join) |
| `CORDON_GUIDE` | `"true"` | briefly cordon non-target nodes so the pod lands where computed |
| `CORDON_GUIDE_STS` | `"false"` | StatefulSets: keep off — PV zone affinity leaves too few candidate nodes |
| `CORDON_POOLS` | `""` | fallback cordon scope when pod context is unavailable |
| `CORDON_TTL_MIN` | `"10"` | heal self-cordoned nodes older than this many minutes |
| `LANDING_GUARD` | `"true"` | verify the landing node; cool the workload down if it breaks a ceiling |
| `AUTO_DOWNGRADE` | `"true"` | rewrite MODE to dry-run after a migration failure (does not self-recover) |
| `ACT_MISSING_POLICY` | `"skip"` | pods without metrics: skip (recommended) or zero |

## notifications

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `NOTIFY_ENABLED` | `"true"` | DingTalk webhook; requires the Secret referenced above |
| `NOTIFY_TITLE` | `"node-leveler"` | card title |
| `NOTIFY_MIN_INTERVAL_MIN` | `"180"` | per-alert-class rate limit |
